message.content:
Gas-fired condensing hydronic boilers for heating water fall under heading 8403 (central heating boilers other than those of heading 8402). Subheading 8403.10 covers boilers, and 8403.10.30 and 8403.10.60 are the statistical suffix lines under it.

HTSUS 8403.10.30 is "Central heating boilers: Boilers: Of iron or steel" – I recall that 8403.10.30 is for "Hot water boilers" and 8403.10.60 is "Other". HTSUS 8403.10.30 reads "Of iron or steel," and 8403.10.60 reads "Other."

The stainless-steel heat exchanger makes the boiler of iron or steel, so 8403.10.30 applies. The 10-digit statistical suffix is 8403.10.3000 for this line.

Checking against CBP rulings, the Absolute Spire boilers are likely the subject of a recent ruling, which probably classified them in 8403.10.30. I'll go with that.
